english.title: Fail to surrender vehicle excise licence after cheque dishonoured
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a notice requiring you to deliver up a vehicle licence within seven days of the posting of that notice, the licence having been granted upon receipt of a cheque which was subsequently dishonoured
english.legislation: Contrary to section 102(2) and (3)(aa) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

english.notes: (i) Whilst this offence has not been repealed, it should not be used following the abolition of tax discs on 1st October 2014. Essentially, there is no longer a physical licence for the person to surrender.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale or an amount equal to five times the annual rate of duty that was payable on the grant of a licence or would have been so payable if it had been taken out for a period of twelve months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
